meta.title: Add unified performance message support to ntttcp test cases
meta.body_summary: Add unified performance message sending for ntttcp TCP/UDP metrics to existing test infrastructure, following patterns from prior PRs.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added observability methods; reviewer flagged missing MetricRelativity attribute for throughput_in_gbps, PR closed without follow-up fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 97 added lines across two files, this is a small-scope additive change. The closed outcome suggests that even small observability additions can be rejected if they miss required domain-specific attributes.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer LiliDeng noted that throughput_in_gbps should have MetricRelativity=HigherIsBetter; the unified message call omitted this attribute that is required by the framework.
review_details.performance_claim: Add unified performance message support for ntttcp test cases to improve test result reporting consistency.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer left a review comment about missing MetricRelativity; PR closed without follow-up, indicating the change was not accepted.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent added metric sending methods but omitted the required MetricRelativity attribute for throughput_in_gbps, a domain-specific detail in the LISA test framework.

detection_detail.code_reading: LiliDeng's inline review comment pointed out the missing MetricRelativity based on manual code inspection of the unified message method.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or test runs required; review was purely static code analysis.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The PR was closed without merge after the unresolved review comment; no fix commits were added.

core_change_summary.description: Added send_ntttcp_tcp_unified_perf_messages() and send_ntttcp_udp_unified_perf_messages() methods in lisa/tools/ntttcp.py, and called them from perf_ntttcp() in microsoft/testsuites/performance/common.py to emit 11 TCP and 7 UDP metrics as unified messages.
change_trajectory: Commit 61c5d13e added 76 lines in ntttcp.py and 21 lines in common.py with no deletions.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out that throughput_in_gbps should have MetricRelativity=HigherIsBetter; the new unified message call did not set this.
Formal review COMMENTED with no body text.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with unified message support for ntttcp.
LiliDeng submitted an inline review comment about missing MetricRelativity ~7.6 hours later.
No follow-up commits were pushed; PR closed by LiliDeng ~12 hours after review.
